summary: Discusses and formalizes channel binding: tying authentication done at a higher layer to the secure channel set up at a lower layer, so both sides know they are the same endpoints. This lets applications rely on lower-layer protection while still getting the assurance they need. It also describes the pros, cons and security considerations.

eli5.summary: Imagine a secret phone call. Channel binding is checking that the person you proved your identity to is the very same person on the line, not someone cutting in between.

questions: how to bind authentication to a secure channel
